ck_bug_reproduction.name: ck_bug_reproduction
ck_bug_reproduction.value: ("app"."bug"."reproduction_unknown" = true) OR ("app"."bug"."reproduction" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("app"."bug"."reproduction")) > 0)

ck_project_env_var_ref.name: ck_project_env_var_ref
ck_project_env_var_ref.value: ("app"."project_env_var"."kind" = 'credential_ref' and "app"."project_env_var"."credential_id" is not null and "app"."project_env_var"."value_text" is null) or ("app"."project_env_var"."kind" = 'plain' and "app"."project_env_var"."credential_id" is null and "app"."project_env_var"."value_text" is not null)

ck_requirement_content_fields.name: ck_requirement_content_fields
ck_requirement_content_fields.value:
(
    ("app"."requirement"."content_mode" = 'markdown' AND "app"."requirement"."content_markdown" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("app"."requirement"."content_markdown")) > 0)
    OR ("app"."requirement"."content_mode" = 'external_link' AND "app"."requirement"."external_url" IS NOT NULL AND length(btrim("app"."requirement"."external_url")) > 0)
  )
